$comment: Häfele Germany runs Intershop Commerce Management (window.ish_pipelinepath, /prod-live/static/WFS/Haefele-HEX-Site/, AWSALB cookies) and the pages are server-rendered, so a plain GET returns the whole product page. The host sits behind Cloudflare, which answers a client that runs no JavaScript with HTTP 403 and 'cf-mitigated: challenge' ('Just a moment...'), so the service reports BOT_PROTECTION for this site unless the challenge is passed elsewhere. Prices are hidden from anonymous visitors: div.hfl-productprice is still in the HTML but display:none, the '#productPriceInformation' block is empty and only div.price-upon-request holds the words 'Preis auf Anfrage', also hidden, while the browser shows an 'In den Warenkorb' button and no price at all, so price_current, price_regular, price_area and availability are not configured and every product comes back whole with price.state 'unknown' and a PRICE_MISSING warning; locale.price_unit is eur so the response still says currency EUR (amounts, when a price ever appears, are cents). There is no visible stock text either: the three span.availability-flag-text strings are the legend of a hover help box and #specialStockMessages / #salesBlockedMessages are hidden containers. The gallery is server-rendered as relative /prod-live/... paths with the primary photo first (ppic-*, then apic-*, dimd-*, illu-*, mont-*), inside one div.productImagePanelInner; div.productImageWrapper is not specific enough because the recommendation carousels in the same root reuse it. The description is the prose block div.productPropertiesIntro, and the specifications are the separate div.productPropertiesSection blocks (h3.productPropertiesSectionHeader plus div.productPropertiesSectionBody), so the description does not repeat them: 7 pairs (Werkstoff, Farbe/Oberfläche, Einsatzbereich, Montage, Funktion, Temperaturbereich, Maße (L x B x H)); the eighth section holds the care instructions under 'Weitere Informationen' and has no heading, so readSpecs skips it. Product URLs are /de/product/<slug>/P-<id>/ while category pages are /de/products/... (plural) and info pages /de/info/..., so match tells them apart by shape. The page carries a canonical link, so product.url is the canonical URL. Checked against the live page of the Universalverbinder Häfele Ixconnect UC 16/64 (Art.-Nr. 262.00.100) on 2026-11-12, fetched once through a browser to get past the challenge.
